mapper.select: SELECT sc.C_Name AS companyName, sc.C_Type AS companyType, sc.C_ContactPerson AS contactPerson, sc.C_ContactPersonTel AS contactPersonTel, p.con_estimated_amount_total AS conEstimatedAmountTotal, p.batch_code AS batchCode, sc.C_ID AS companyId, -- 合同暂估价：按 getFinishedContractMoneyByCompanyIds 逻辑查询合同总金额 COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(c.Con_Money_Total) FROM Con_Contract c WHERE c.Con_Approval_State = 7 AND ( c.Con_Party_B_Id = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B1 = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B2 = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B3 = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B4 = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B5 = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B6 = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B7 = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B8 = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B9 = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B10 = sc.C_ID ) ), 0) AS usedContractMoney, -- 合同支付金额：按相同逻辑查询已支付金额 COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(cp.Pay_Apply) FROM Con_Pay cp INNER JOIN Con_Contract c ON cp.Con_Id = c.Con_Id WHERE c.Con_Approval_State = 7 AND cp.Pay_State = 7 AND cp.Pay_Category = '01' AND ( c.Con_Party_B_Id = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B1 = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B2 = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B3 = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B4 = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B5 = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B6 = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B7 = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B8 = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B9 = sc.C_ID OR c.Con_Party_B10 = sc.C_ID ) ), 0) AS paidContractMoney FROM framework_agreement_party p INNER JOIN framework_agreement_company_id_list cil ON p.id = cil.framework_agreement_party_id INNER JOIN SYS_Company sc ON cil.sys_company_id = sc.C_ID WHERE p.party_type = #{applyType} AND sc.C_Type = p.party_type GROUP BY sc.C_Name, sc.C_Type, sc.C_ContactPerson, sc.C_ContactPersonTel, p.con_estimated_amount_total, p.batch_code, sc.C_ID
